desc: The Exchange has sought clarification from Vodafone Idea Ltd on 2026-08-25, with reference to news appeared in https://www.moneycontrol.com/ dated 2026-08-25 quoting "Delhi HC raps I-T dept over Rs 53 crore Vodafone Idea refund delay".<BR><BR>The reply is awaited.
Vodafone Idea has informed the Exchange regarding ESG Rating of the Company for FY 2026 by CRISIL ESG Ratings and Analytics Limited
Vodafone Idea has informed the Exchange regarding Change in logo
Vodafone Idea has informed the Exchange regarding media release on new brand identity.
